title: Villa Jules | KEY.co
description_expanded: With three of the five bedrooms offering panoramic ocean views, every guest can wake up to the mesmerizing sight of the Pacific Ocean from the comfort of their bed. This two-story coastal gem features a fully equipped kitchen complete with high-end stainless steel appliances, a spacious kitchen island, and an adjacent dining area that can comfortably seat up to eight guests. Multiple indoor living spaces, including a charming glass-enclosed sunroom, provide ample room for relaxation and entertainment. The living room offers not only ocean views but also a Smart TV, ensuring you stay connected or unwind with your favorite shows. An electric fireplace adds both warmth and ambiance to your evenings. The dining area beckons with a well-appointed dining table, while the fully equipped kitchen boasts everything you need to prepare delicious meals, from a gas range stove to a Keurig coffee maker with complimentary K-cup pods. All the essential amenities, including cookware, glassware, dinnerware, and utensils, are provided to make your stay as convenient as it is delightful. Experience the ultimate coastal getaway, where the magic of the ocean meets the comforts of home.

Features: Quiet hours outdoors start at 9PM. No parties are allowed.
